# telnyx_billing_groups (Data Source)

Lists billing groups, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_billing_group`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only
